audio.description: [Built-in] Basic audio configurations to initialize the SDK object. 16k for wideband and 48k for super wideband voice. If channels > 1, down mix into mono.

aec.description: [Built-in] Echo cancellation. Enable mobile if it runs on resource-limited device

rnnoise.description: blend_factor: 0.0 = no denoising (preserves all input), 1.0 = full RNNoise (aggressive denoising). Recommended: 0.7-0.9 for better speech preservation

gain_control.description: [Built-in] Adaptive gain control. Enable agc1 and agc2 by default

sys_out_gain.description: [Built-in] System or playback audio volumn control
